Workspace hygiene pass for the Archon Horizon workspace at /home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon, requested by lane `ajcr-p1` (run 0087) before its final report.

SCOPE — this is a one-session-per-round prover lane, so keep it tight and do not rewrite other lanes' state:

1. INBOX OVERFLOW is the loudest warning: `horizon inbox list` reports ~378+ open non-protection items against a recommended max of 30, and roughly 325 unread. Ten lanes have been filing all day. Please triage: archive or complete items that are demonstrably CONSUMED (superseded CLAIM notices whose lane has since RELEASEd, duplicate shared-index-hazard reports — there are now at least five near-identical ones: I-1070, I-1081, I-1082, I-1083, I-1085, I-1126 — and stale info/temporary items). Do NOT archive any `protection` item (I-0074, I-0491, I-0492, I-0838, I-0839), and do not archive open `issue` items that name a live defect nobody has fixed.

2. MY OWN TRAIL, please check and clean if warranted. Lane `ajcr-p1` filed this round: I-1063 (CLAIM atlas-coupling), I-1081 (shared-index fourth mode), I-1125 (the coverage finding), I-1128 (RELEASE atlas-coupling), plus DMs to task:ajcr-p2 and task:ajcr-p4. Earlier rounds of the same lane filed I-0869, I-0965 (both CLAIM notices, both superseded by releases), I-0950, I-0890, I-1012, I-1016, I-1017 (conversation with p2). The two superseded CLAIM notices from earlier rounds (I-0869, I-0965) should almost certainly be archived; I-1063 is superseded by I-1128. Check whether my conversation thread I-1017 and I-1068 (review-ajcr's urgent thread to me, which I answered) are consumed and closeable — note I-1068's initiator is review-ajcr, so its closure is theirs, not mine, but say so if it looks done.

3. ROADMAP CONSISTENCY warnings currently printed on every command: `AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-glue: every sub-item is done — consider marking done` (do NOT mark it done — I-0971's comment records the reason, and a janitor already agreed) and `Roadmap has 32 active items (recommended max 8)`. For the active-item count, report which rows are `active` with NO live owner from this round's ten lanes (`review-ajc`, `review-ajcr`, `ajc-p1..p4`, `ajcr-p1..p4`) — those are candidates for `pending`. Per protection I-0839, an owner value outside those ten is a DEAD lane's residue.

4. SCRATCH DIRECTORIES under MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/: `scratch_p2r2`, `scratch_review_ground`, `scratch_w7`, and possibly `scratch_review_ajcr` and `wrev_scratch`. Report which are TRACKED in the ledger (those are real hygiene debt) versus merely untracked on disk (leave those — they may belong to a live lane). A work-reviewer noted `scratch_review_ajcr/Ax.lean` contains a live `sorry`. I already removed my own `scratch_p1r2`.

CONSTRAINTS: the ledger index is shared by ten concurrent writers and has already produced five distinct data-loss/misattribution modes today. If you commit anything, stage EXPLICIT paths, never `add -A` or a directory, and verify content by hash AFTER committing (`git show HEAD:<path> | sha256sum` vs the file) rather than trusting the commit sha. Do NOT use `git read-tree HEAD` (it silently reverts other lanes' unstaged work — recorded as I-0999). Never `git reset --hard` or `git clean`.

Report what you changed, what you deliberately left, and any warning that survives with the reason.
